meta.method: Per 15 s window of AMI's timed human words: share of its distinctive bigrams (at least one word not a stop word and longer than 3 characters) found anywhere in the product transcript; windows with fewer than 3 such bigrams are skipped; share >= threshold counts as captured. Control: an unrelated meeting's human transcript scored as the product.
meta.corpus: AMI Meeting Corpus manual annotations 1.6.2 (CC BY 4.0)
